messages:
tara: QA found a billing mismatch after a streaming retry that hit a router preemption. Looks like provisional rows persisted + a later final row, customer complained about apparent double billing. Logs below.

leo: paste the snippet + route/model?

tara: model=rwd-6b-quant, route=ap-southeast-1-fastpool. Snip: `2026-06-07T03:08:10Z stream.start sid=xx-77 seq=0`, `2026-06-07T03:08:11Z router.handoff from=pool-12 to=pool-3 claim=tmp-42`, `2026-06-07T03:08:11Z toolcall.ack seq=34 client_eof=true truncated=true`, `2026-06-07T03:08:12Z ledger.emit provisional id=pv-440 tokens=198`, `2026-06-07T03:08:13Z ledger.emit final id=fn-441 tokens=96 confirmed=true`

devops-bot: Incident INC-2040-078 created and assigned to @leo.

ash: quick observation: provisional is larger than final. Our intended invariant is final replaces provisional. If both show in invoice, tombstone was missing or not joined correctly by console.

mina: do we have a durable handoff identifier today? IIRC router uses ephemeral claim ids and client side re-creates them on reconnect. That kills dedupe.

leo: exactly. Proposal A: introduce `x-handoff-id` that the router assigns on first claim and client libs persist across reconnects for the logical request. Pass it to all child requests (prefetch, embeddings) as `x-parent-handoff`.

rafa: ledger side: store `handoff_id` on provisional/final/tombstone rows. Tombstone should be a first-class row: `type=tombstone prev_row=pv-440 prev_tokens=198 last_ack=34` so UI and audits can join.

tara: UI/UX ask: console should group rows by `handoff_id` and show a compact timeline: [provisional 198 -> tombstone -> final 96]. Add small banner: "Provisional charges are optimistic; final is authoritative" with a link to FAQ. Default view: collapsed by handoff id to avoid scaring customers.

ash: runtime caveat: we must handle races where old shard confirms while new shard emits tombstone. Suggest ledger CAS semantics keyed by `handoff_id` so writes are ordered: the first successful confirm wins and tombstone is a conditional update.

mina: metrics/alerts: we need `billing.duplicates.count` (sessions with >1 active charge row after 2m), `ledger.tombstone.count`, `ledger.tombstone.latency_ms`, and `console.grouping.rate`. Dashboards: top offending routes, percent duplicates resolved by tombstones, and median tombstone latency. Alert if duplicates_rate > 0.3% cluster-wide for 5m.

leo: internal API debate: should tombstone be a full ledger record or an attribute on provisional row (`state=stale`)? Full row is simpler for audit trail but increases write rate and retention. Attribute is compact but harder to model history. Thoughts?

rafa: prefer full tombstone row. We already retain ledger rows for 90d; an extra row per truncated case is acceptable and gives clear audit trail + simpler joins.

ash: runtime implementation note: tombstone emitter must include `last_ack_seq` and `last_token_count` to avoid ambiguous cancellation. Example event: `{"handoff_id":"h-zz-901","prev_row":"pv-440","last_ack":34,"prev_tokens":198}`. We'll store flattened fields in ledger.

mina: rollout UX: Phase 1 (internal): ship `x-handoff-id` header in canary and accept tombstone rows in ledger; console hidden toggle to view tombstones. Phase 2: enable console grouping and add metrics panels (1 week observation). Phase 3: consider automated small credits where tombstone exists and final < provisional (post manual audit).

tara: tests: add integration harness that fuzzes these sequences: handoff + truncated toolcall + concurrent confirm + tombstone races. Add DB-level CAS unit tests. Add UI e2e asserting grouping behavior.

leo: backfill: for historical invoices we can best-effort group rows by session + time window and add a `backfill_group_id` script, but multi-route races can't be resolved automatically. Create GH task to run backfill and audit sample.

rafa: infra note: tombstone writes may increase contention on ledger partition keyed by handoff_id. We'll shard tombstone writes by `handoff_prefix` to distribute load and measure WAL throughput during canary.

mina: console change: show a small timeline graph in the billing detail pane, and add an "Explain" popover with exact sequence of events + route chain. Also add a one-click CSV export for finance disputes.

ash: security + audit: ensure tombstone events are logged to audit stream with immutable ids; include user-facing claim ids so finance can reconcile with customer support tickets.

leo: internal API naming: prefer lower-case header `x-handoff-id` and optional `x-handoff-reason`. Also add `x-invoice-group` for grouping separate background children under same invoice.

tara: owners: runtime=leo, ledger=rafa, console=mina, product=tara. I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri to review dashboards and canary plan.

devops-bot: Created GH issue rwd/infra#4910 (handoff-id + tombstone + console grouping).

mina: ack console owner. Will prototype grouping and minimal UX copy.

rafa: ack ledger owner. I'll sketch tombstone schema and metrics.

leo: ack runtime. I'll modify router and client lib to persist `x-handoff-id` across reconnects and emit tombstone on truncation.

tara: thanks all. Filing incident INC-2040-078 with GH link and test plan.
